subject: art-design
title: Shapes — Geometric & Organic
welcome_lead: From perfect circles to wobbly puddles.
meta_desc: KS3 shape: geometric vs organic shapes, simple to complex.
final_note: Every drawing breaks down to simple shapes underneath.

walkthroughs.body_html: Geometric shapes include circles, squares, triangles, rectangles, hexagons, octagons. They feel ordered, modern, sometimes mechanical.
Organic shapes come from nature — leaves, clouds, pebbles, puddles. They have curves and asymmetry. They feel softer, more natural.
Try drawing a person as just simple shapes: oval head, rectangle torso, cylinder limbs. Refine later. This is how illustrators and animators build characters.
